LESSON: LANGUAGE USE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.9: Language Use

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Language Use
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can you improve your speaking skill?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. recognise objects from an oral text
2. describe positions of objects in relation to others for comprehension
3. appreciate speaking skills to convey information accurately

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 3: appreciate speaking skills to convey information accurately

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: recognise objects from an oral text
2. Practise: describe positions of objects in relation to others for comprehension
3. Practise: appreciate speaking skills to convey information accurately

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Language Use.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you improve your speaking skill?
2. Why does the position of objects affect their description?
